docs/adr/0035-reconciler-vendor-adapter-seam.md:150-153: 'Callers detect a capability by an `isinstance`-guarded check ... capability is observed via behavior, not structural introspection.'
advisory.finding: `run_differs.py` and `outbound_differ.py` access `backend.link_type_for_relation` unconditionally off the plain `Backend` facade, but that method is declared ONLY on the opt-in `SupportsLinks` capability Protocol (not on the `Backend` facade). A backend that satisfies the `Backend` facade contract but does not implement the links capability — the documented `FakeBackend`, and the intended shape of any future non-link backend — has no `link_type_for_relation` attribute, so the access raises `AttributeError`. This violates the ADR-0035 capability contract, which requires capabilities to be reached only via an `isinstance(backend, SupportsLinks)` guard.
scenarios: A `FakeBackend` (or any future non-Jira backend that supports the facade but not links) is selected and `run_differs`/`compute_outbound_mutations` runs → `AttributeError: 'FakeBackend' object has no attribute 'link_type_for_relation'`.
A direct caller invokes `compute_outbound_mutations` omitting `link_resolver` with a links-less backend configured → registry fallback at outbound_differ.py:447 raises AttributeError.
advisory.suggested_fix: Either add `link_type_for_relation` to the `Backend` facade Protocol and implement it on `FakeBackend`, or guard the access: `link_resolver = backend.link_type_for_relation if isinstance(backend, SupportsLinks) else (lambda _r: None)` — matching the existing `_sync_links_if_supported` capability-gating pattern.
